text:
nora_ops: @here quick update: we're opening a small preview pool in Reykjavik (reyk1) today for regional latency testing. Pool: `dedicated-L70e-reyk1-preview`. Initial capacity = 8 cards. :iceland:

ekaterina_pm: Nice. Any special billing or reservation notes?

nora_ops: Preview pricing applies. Reservations allowed. Fallback chain: reyk1 -> lon1 -> hosted-global. Fallbacks will be visible in console.

sam_sre: Rollout timing and alerting? Need probes on dashboards.

nora_ops: Canary starts 2026-06-01T11:00Z for 1h, then expand to preview. Probes: `reyk1-l70e-smoke` and `reyk1-l70e-p95`. Pause if fallback >5% in 15m or error rate >0.4%. Runbook: internal link added to ops wiki.

josh_sales: I'll ping pilot customers in EMEA. Migration CLI example?

nora_ops: CLI snippet to reserve:
```
# reserve 2 cards in reyk1 for 7 days
rb-reserve --pool dedicated-L70e-reyk1-preview --size 2 --duration 7d
```

anya_ce: Are quant profiles preloaded or do customers need a one-time compile?

sam_sre: We ship two default profiles (fp8-std and int8-lite). Custom models may need compile; reservation UI warns about it.

ekaterina_pm: Can we add a console banner: "reyk1 L70e preview may fallback to LON1 during canary"?

nora_ops: Will add banner and enable detailed fallback logging for 48h.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for `dedicated-L70e-reyk1-preview` at 2026-06-01T11:00:08Z (canary).

nora_ops: Ops anchors: watch token p95, KV cache hit-rate, fallback %, and error-rate. CE/Sales brief scheduled tomorrow 08:30 PT. Calendar invite sent. :white_check_mark:
